response.sql: WITH race_names AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS laps_count FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_names) SELECT SUM(rn.total_points) AS total_points, SUM(rn.avg_laps * rn.laps_count) / NULLIF(SUM(rn.laps_count), 0) AS avg_laps, AVG(rn.total_points - t.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM race_names AS rn CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE rn.total_points > t.avg_total;
